I farm this small piece of land alone with my family, and this year I did not get the coupon for fertilizer — without it I cannot afford the shop prices, especially with the little cash we have. I will put the manure from our goats and chickens on the plot, and plant the maize seed I saved from last harvest together with pigeon peas between the rows, the way my mother taught me. I will do all the work myself with my family — hoeing ridges, weeding twice, and harvesting — because paying ganyu is beyond us. Without chemicals, I just pray the rains come well.
